title: statespace claim card, version 1
description: A claim card in the learner's lab repository (claims/*.yaml): six fields (proposition, assumptions, model, method, correspondence, and the counterexample when weakened) plus the requirement row, as sketched in ARCHITECTURE.md section 8.2 and spine section 5.2. No field holds a stamp: stamps are derived from receipts and never typed, so a card that carries one is rejected as an unknown field. An agent's proposed claim carries agent: true and lives in proposals/, where it is shown as quoted UNREVIEWED text and never stamped. This schema checks the shape; GATE-claims and claim@1 validation in the CLI also check that the method matches the receipt, that the statement hash matches the pinned file and that the if_weakened witness refutes this card's own proposition.

id.description: The learner's local identifier for this card.

template.description: The claim template the card instantiates. Absent for a claim no template covers; claim@1 validation accepts those (spine section 5.2).

proposition.description: Field 1: what the claim says, in the learner's words.

statement.description: The pinned statement the claim is about, identified by path; its hash comes from the receipt. Absent for a claim with no statement file, such as an assumed or composite claim.

path.description: The statement file: a Lean challenge, a TLA+ spec or an SMT-LIB file.

theorem.description: The Lean theorem name, for a Lean statement.

property.description: The TLA+ property or invariant name, for a TLA+ statement.

assumptions.description: Field 2: what the claim assumes. The list may be empty; an assumption that names a seam is planted for erosion.

model.description: Field 3: the model the proposition is about.

method.description: Field 4: how the claim was established. receipt names the receipt whose verdicts carry the stamp; tool and version are prefilled from it. A claim with no receipt describes its method in text.

correspondence.description: Field 5: how the model corresponds to the system, or what is not covered.

if_weakened.description: Field 6: the counterexample when an assumption is weakened. It must refute this card's own proposition, which GATE-claims checks. specimen names the specimen record that holds the witness.

requirement.description: The requirement row: the requirement the claim is meant to serve. Its fit is never [P].

rests_on.description: The cards this claim depends on, by local identifier.

supersedes.description: The card this one replaces, or null. The older card stays in the erosion log.

agent.description: True when an agent proposed the card (proposals/). Such a card is never stamped.
